dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, tell me about the school you volunteer at.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈtɛl miː əˈbaʊt ðə ˈskuːl juː ˌvɑːlənˈtɪr ˈæt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's a small school in a rural part of Nan. Most of the families there are in need.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ə ˈsmɔːl ˈskuːl ɪn ə ˈrʊrəl ˈpɑːrt əv ˈnɑːn. ˈmoʊst əv ðə ˈfæməliz ˈðɛr ər ɪn ˈniːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And the children you teach? How old are they?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈtʃɪldrən juː ˈtiːtʃ? ˈhaʊ ˈoʊld ər ðeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: From seven to twelve. They're shy, but they love games.
dialogue.reading: frəm ˈsɛvən tə ˈtwɛlv. ðɛr ˈʃaɪ, bʌt ðeɪ ˈlʌv ˈɡeɪmz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A local teacher, Ms. Daeng. She's the person I learn the most from.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈloʊkəl ˈtiːtʃər, ˈmɪz ˈdɛŋ. ʃiːz ðə ˈpɜːrsən aɪ ˈlɜːrn ðə ˈmoʊst ˈfrʌm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Are there any children with special needs?
dialogue.reading: ər ðɛr ˈɛni ˈtʃɪldrən wɪð ˈspɛʃəl ˈniːdz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, two. One boy is disabled and can't walk, but he's the best at math in the class!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈtuː. ˈwʌn ˈbɔɪ ɪz dɪsˈeɪbəld ənd ˈkænt ˈwɔːk, bʌt hiːz ðə ˈbɛst ət ˈmæθ ɪn ðə ˈklæs!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's great. By the way, the nursing home I volunteer at needs more people, too.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡreɪt. baɪ ðə ˈweɪ, ðə ˈnɜːrsɪŋ ˌhoʊm aɪ ˌvɑːlənˈtɪr ˈæt ˈniːdz ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Which one? The one near our house?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɪtʃ ˈwʌn? ðə ˈwʌn ˈnɪr aʊr ˈhaʊs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, the one I told you about. The old people there love visitors.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðə ˈwʌn aɪ ˈtoʊld juː əˈbaʊt. ði ˈoʊld ˈpiːpəl ˈðɛr ˈlʌv ˈvɪzɪtərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then I'll come with you next Wednesday evening.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈkʌm wɪð juː ˈnɛkst ˈwɛnzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ.
